title: G00N SQUAD check-in
description: A friendly check-in with a member who has gone quiet (offered by the check-in campaigns in contracts/checkin.json): how they've been, what kept them away, and what would bring them back. Answers are recorded per member for G00N SQUAD leadership.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}, thanks for stopping by! A few quick questions so we know what would make G00N SQUAD worth coming back to. Your answers go to G00N SQUAD leadership. Nothing is sent until you confirm at the end, and Cancel stops at any point.

away.say: What's kept you away lately? Pick everything that fits, or Skip.

options.label: Taking a break from Star Citizen
Waiting on a patch
options.description: Bugs, performance, or a feature I want

options.label: Hard to find people to play with
Didn't know what was going on
Something in the community didn't sit right

back.say: What would bring you back? Pick everything that fits.

options.label: Fleet ops at times I can make
Help getting back up to speed

when.say: When do you usually play (your local time)? Pick everything that fits.

reach.say: Would you like someone from G00N SQUAD to reach out when something's on that fits?

options.label: No thanks, I'll check the schedule

notes.say: Anything else you want leadership to know? Skip if not.

complete.say: Thanks, that's with G00N SQUAD leadership now. This week's events are at {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/events, and voice is open any time. Hope to see you in the 'verse!

cancelled.say: No worries, nothing was sent. The door's always open: this week's events are at {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/events
